name: PhysioPal
tagline: An on-device physiotherapy app that adapts exercises to your health data, checks your form and calls your therapist if needed.
problem: Patients do home exercises wrong and unsupervised; cloud cameras raise privacy worries.
solution: Reads Apple Health to adjust the routine, runs pose estimation on the phone to count reps and correct form, and escalates to the physiotherapist by phone call.
demo_moment: Team-described: a poor night's sleep turns squats into chair squats; a form error gets spoken feedback.

why_it_stood_out.claim: The camera feed never leaves the phone.

lessons: Privacy is a feature when the user is elderly and the camera is pointed at them.
